info.title: REST Countries API
info.description:
The Countries API is a read-only API for country data. Every endpoint returns JSON, authenticates via a single bearer token, and runs against the same dataset as the demos on the homepage. No SDK is required.

The dataset covers 90+ normalized fields per country (codes, capitals, currencies, languages, borders, geography, memberships, locale conventions, and links). All endpoints are GET; there is no POST/PUT/DELETE surface.

Response shapes follow JSON:API conventions: successful payloads sit under a top-level `data` key (with response metadata nested inside `data.meta`), and failures come back under `errors` as an array of objects carrying a `message` and a machine-readable `code`.

Breaking changes ship as a new major version (e.g. /v6), with indefinite support for previous versions.

Documentation: https://restcountries.com/docs/countries

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of all countries. Defaults to `limit=25`; max `limit` is 100 on the free plan, or up to 500 on a paid plan. Adding `q` and/or any searchable `{property}` as a query parameter narrows the list as a case-insensitive substring search; all clauses AND together. An explicitly empty `q` returns 400.

Dynamic `{property}` filters (e.g. `region=Europe`, `names.common=ger`, `memberships.eu=1`) are additionally accepted but cannot be enumerated in this document.

Search across a named bundle of properties in one call. An object matches if any one of the underlying properties contains `q` (substring, case-insensitive). Two aggregates are predefined:

- `name` — searches `names.common`, `names.official`, `names.alternates`, `names.native` (translations intentionally excluded)
- `code` — searches `codes.alpha_2`, `codes.alpha_3`, `codes.ccn3`, `codes.fips`, `codes.gec`, `codes.fifa`, `codes.cioc`

Empty `q` returns 400. If the path segment is not a known aggregate name, the request falls through to *Search by property*.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term. Substring-matched against the aggregate's underlying property list. Returns 400 if explicitly empty (e.g. `?q=`).

get.description: Substring search within a single searchable property. For example `/countries/v5/names.common?q=ger` finds every country whose common name contains "ger". `q` is required and returns 400 if explicitly empty.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring search term for the given property.

get.description: Exact match (case-insensitive). The `{value}` segment must equal the property's value in full; use *Search by property* for substring matching. Works for unique identifiers (`codes.alpha_2/CA`, `names.common/Canada`), group properties (`region/Europe`), and reverse lookups on array fields (`borders/CAN` returns the countries that border Canada). `+` and `%20` are both decoded as spaces, so `capitals/new+delhi` and `capitals/new%20delhi` resolve. Boolean properties accept `true` or `false`. Optional `q` further narrows the matched set.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Exact property value (case-insensitive; `+` and `%20` decode as spaces).

410.description: API version is no longer active.

ApiKey.name: Authorization
ApiKey.description: Every endpoint requires an API key. Recommended form is a bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`. The bare form (no Bearer prefix) is also accepted, and as a last resort the key can be passed as an `api-key` query parameter (useful for browser-based experiments; beware leakage into logs and history). A public demo key `rc_live_demo` works for sample requests without an account.

Property.name: property
Property.description: A readable/searchable property dot-path, e.g. `codes.alpha_2`, `names.common`, `region`, `subregion`, `capitals`, `borders`, `currencies`, `calling_codes`, `landlocked`, `memberships.eu`, `leaders`. Non-unique group/array properties return multiple records. Filtering or searching by a premium field (e.g. `leaders`) on the free plan returns 403.

Q.name: q
Q.description: Free-text search across every searchable property. Substring match, case-insensitive; `+` and `%20` are both decoded as spaces. An explicitly empty `q` returns 400.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. 1-100 on the free plan, or up to 500 on a paid plan. Defaults to 25.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Skip this many (matched) records before returning. Defaults to 0.

ResponseFields.name: response_fields
ResponseFields.description: Allowlist of properties to include in each returned object (comma-separated dot-paths, e.g. `names.common,codes.alpha_2,flag.emoji`). When set, the response carries only those properties. Omit to return every field.

ResponseFieldsOmit.name: response_fields_omit
ResponseFieldsOmit.description: Blocklist of properties to drop from each returned object (comma-separated dot-paths, e.g. `names.translations`). Composes with `response_fields`: the response is first projected to `response_fields`, then pruned by this list (the omit list wins on conflict).

Pretty.name: pretty
Pretty.description: Pretty-print the JSON response. The bare flag (`?pretty`) and truthy values (`true`, `1`) enable; anything else (including `false` and `0`) leaves the response compact.

objects.description: The matched country records (shape depends on the 90+ field dataset; see the Field reference and `response_fields`).

count.description: Number of records in this response.

more.description: Whether more records exist beyond this page.

code.description: Machine-readable code that stays stable even if the message wording changes (e.g. `general.limit_out_of_range`).

BadRequest.description: Malformed request: empty `q`, out-of-range `limit`, or another query-parameter validation failure.

errors.message: Limit must be an integer between 1 and 100.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, unrecognized, revoked, or expired API key (both Authorization header and `?api-key=` query-param forms).

Forbidden.description: Account frozen (monthly request limit exceeded), or a Free-plan account searched/filtered by a premium field such as `leaders`.

NotFound.description: Path doesn't match a known endpoint, or the property/aggregate isn't readable/searchable.

TooManyRequests.description: Edge rate limiter rejected sustained traffic above 20 requests per 10 seconds.
